hero.title: BBA in the USA for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue an accredited Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in the USA, establishing foundational expertise across finance, marketing, organizational management, and international business. Indian students gain practical corporate exposure and explore Optional Practical Training (OPT) employment opportunities, subject to US immigration regulations.

overview: A Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) is an undergraduate degree designed to develop business knowledge, management skills and leadership capabilities.
The United States offers students opportunities to study business through hands-on projects, case studies, applicable internships, and industry-focused coursework.

Edu Hawk Worldwide assists students in exploring international study options, comprehending university admission standards, comparing pathways like Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) and MBA in the USA.

faqs.q: Indian students can pursue BBA in the USA after Class 12?
faqs.a: Yes. Students from India who meet the academic, English language and other admission requirements can apply for undergraduate business administration programs in the USA.

faqs.q: What is the duration of BBA in USA?
faqs.a: A full-time bachelor’s degree in business administration usually takes four years, however, the duration may vary depending on the university and study plan.

faqs.q: Is Math a required subject for BBA in USA?
faqs.a: Not in every university. There are programs that require specific math preparation, and others that have different prerequisites. Students should refer to requirements for each program.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to study BBA in the USA?
faqs.a: Tuition can vary widely with broad estimates of USD 15,000 - 45,000 or more per year. You’ll also have to budget for living costs and additional university fees.

faqs.q: Can students from Science / Humanities backgrounds apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Many undergraduate business programs take students from diverse academic backgrounds if they meet the university's eligibility criteria.

faqs.q: How can Edu Hawk worldwide Consultancy help me study abroad?
faqs.a: Edu Hawk worldwide can help students explore suitable universities, understand admission requirements, organise application documents, and plan their study-abroad journey.
